description: Soft side, and not the king

participation.context: Called the jaw tender, refused a name for the king, and kept to the one word he had written.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the soft side, refused a play at her board, and kept the noon candle unlit.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Measured the loaf, offered broth, and carried the crusts off the board.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: she will not be taken into a playhouse by talk
relations.quote: I do not go to playhouses.

story.body: You kept the afternoon at home, refused the crust, and left the afternoon's casting unnamed.

relations.note: she will not be taken into a playhouse by talk

title: Ate the soft side and stayed home from Richard II
